RL-completion.utility: exact supported centered advantage minus beta KL

C.lineage: original supervised C; no RL updates

bootstrap.unit: unique users sampled with replacement; every original query follows its user
bootstrap.estimand: query-weighted paired mean difference: resampled query-sum / resampled query-count
bootstrap.CI: unadjusted percentile 2.5/97.5, NumPy linear quantiles; common draws for all nine columns

definitions.item_contribution: mean_s (p_right−p_left)*support*(u−E_C[u|supported,s]); sums exactly to paired proxy shift
definitions.conditional_means: Reported with arm-specific probability/top10 denominators; differences are not comparable expected-utility gains.
definitions.exposure: recommended unique top10 items per query; query weighting and equal-user weighting shown separately
definitions.prior: frozen observed-fit item prior m_fit; residual is a proxy, not a causal personalization effect
definitions.H63: membership in original observed truncated token prefix after excluding tokens <3; no generated actions
definitions.popularity: log1p strict7d count at the original matched origin; no lifetime-popularity claim

limitations: Reused development, with screen selection/overlap; exploratory, not untouched holdout.
One fit per utility, fixed beta; this is not a matched-KL comparison or beta sweep.
Conditional on frozen encoder/C/local RM, natural1024 pools and RM support protocol.
RM predictions and residual utility are offline proxies, not observed policy outcomes or causal retention effects.
Full4096 has relevance/exposure only; reward diagnostics belong exclusively to screen256.
Exposure is a recommendation distribution, not actual impressions, satisfaction, watchtime or retention.
No model/provider/raw-data replay, supervised updates, final-test access or policy selection occurs in this analyzer.
